views.body_sql:
SELECT
  a.actor_id,
  a.first_name,
  a.last_name,
  fa.film_id,
  f.language_id,
  f.rating,
  f.length,
  f.release_year,
  fc.category_id
FROM film_actor fa
JOIN actor a ON fa.actor_id = a.actor_id
JOIN film f ON fa.film_id = f.film_id
JOIN film_category fc ON f.film_id = fc.film_id
JOIN language l ON f.language_id = l.language_id
WHERE l.name = 'English'
  AND fc.category_id IS NOT NULL
  AND f.rating IN ('G', 'PG')
  AND f.length <= 120
  AND f.release_year BETWEEN '2000' AND '2010'
views.description:
Task: Identify the single actor who appears as a performer in the largest number of films that meet all specified criteria.
